info.title: AI Workforce Platform - Core API
info.description: Core backend of the AI Workforce Platform. All business endpoints are versioned under /api/v1 and require an OAuth 2.0 bearer access token. Organization-scoped endpoints answer 404 when the caller is not an active member of the organization and 403 when a permission is missing. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details (application/problem+json). Timestamps are UTC, ISO 8601.

tags.name: Employees
tags.description: Employee profiles (professional identity, separate from platform access)

put.summary: Assign or clear the team leader, who must be a current member (team.manage)
Associate the team with a department, or remove the association (team.manage)
Associate the position with a department, or remove the association (position.manage)
Replace a member's roles (member.roles.assign; anti-escalation rules apply)
Change the employment status; to or from INACTIVE needs employee.deactivate
Assign or clear the position; never changes permissions (employee.manage)
Link or unlink the platform membership of the same organization (employee.manage)
Assign or clear the direct manager; reporting cycles are refused (employee.manage)
Change the parent department; cycles are refused (department.manage)
Assign or remove the department head (department.manage)

get.summary: List the organizations the caller is an active member of

post.summary: Create an organization; the caller becomes its OWNER

get.summary: List the team members, optionally with former members (team.read)

post.summary: Add a current employee to the team; duplicates are refused (team.manage)

get.summary: List the roles of an organization (role.read)

post.summary: Create a custom role (role.manage; only permissions the caller holds)
Invite someone by e-mail with a role the caller is allowed to grant (invitation.create)
Create an employee profile, optionally linked to a membership (employee.create)
Archive a department without employees or active sub-departments (department.manage)
Accept an invitation (verified e-mail must match the invitation)

get.summary: Get an organization with the caller's roles and permissions (organization.read)
Get a team with its current members (team.read)

patch.summary: Update a custom role (role.manage; built-in roles are immutable)

delete.summary: Delete a position that was never held; otherwise archive it (position.manage)

patch.summary: Update the scalar fields of an employee (employee.manage)

delete.summary: Delete a department that was never used; otherwise archive it (department.manage)

patch.summary: Update the authenticated user's display name

delete.summary: Remove a member (member.manage), or leave the organization (own membership)

get.summary: Teams an employee currently belongs to (team.read)
List the organization's audit events, newest first (audit.read)

get.description: Returns UP when the application and its database are available.

503.description: Application or one of its dependencies is unavailable

delete.summary: Remove an employee from the team; the leader must be replaced first (team.manage)

AssignTeamLeaderRequest.description: The leader must be a current member. Null clears it.

ChangeTeamDepartmentRequest.description: A null departmentId removes the association.

ChangePositionDepartmentRequest.description: A null departmentId removes the association.

AssignEmployeePositionRequest.description: A null positionId removes the assignment.

LinkEmployeeMembershipRequest.description: A null membershipId unlinks the platform account.

AssignEmployeeManagerRequest.description: A null managerId removes the manager.

AssignEmployeeDepartmentRequest.description: A null departmentId removes the assignment.

ChangeDepartmentParentRequest.description: A null parentId moves the department to the top level.

AssignDepartmentHeadRequest.description: A null employeeId removes the head.

CreateTeamRequest.description: When a leader is given, the leader is added as the first member.

Invitation.description: An invitation. The secret token is only sent by e-mail.

membershipId.description: Optional platform membership of this organization to link to the profile.

expectedVersion.description: When set, the update is refused (409) if the team changed meanwhile.
When set, the update is refused (409) if the position changed meanwhile.

UpdateEmployeeRequest.description: Omitted fields are left unchanged; an empty employeeNumber or professionalEmail clears it.

expectedVersion.description: When set, the update is refused (409) if the employee changed meanwhile.
When set, the update is refused (409) if the department changed meanwhile.

status.description: Aggregated status of the application and its dependencies.

version.description: Application version, used by clients to check compatibility.

bearerAuth.description: Access token issued by the identity provider (Authorization Code + PKCE).
